💡 gander | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide Android users with a private, offline, and comprehensive solution for viewing diverse file types without relying on cloud services or granting unnecessary permissions.
✨ Key Features: • Universal file viewing (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, images, video, audio, Markdown, code, ZIP) • 100% offline functionality • Zero permissions required • No ads or trackers • Small APK size (~5 MB)
📖 Summary: Gander is a lightweight, open-source Android application designed to view a wide variety of file types directly on the device. It prioritizes user privacy and offline functionality by requiring zero permissions and having no internet access, ads, or trackers.
